m4_authority_boundaries: The artifact-class table refuses any role writing outside its profile entry: a Builder cannot write a checker verdict, a Checker cannot write advisor state, an Advisor cannot write verifier state, a serial writer cannot write a merge receipt
Serial integration starts only from exact-SHA accepted inputs
Only one shared-surface integration writer may hold a lease at a time
Final verifier evaluates the exact final tree and SHA; a moved SHA is refused
Merge sheriff requires a verified physical-host enrollment, an exact final PASS, and a one-time founder decision receipt with a valid signature from the pinned founder public key
Founder signature, production activation, deployment and destructive actions are hard stops on M4
M4 Terminal-0 remains the human operating position

founder_receipt.grep_proof: grep -rn -- '-Y sign' tools/role-floor/bin tools/role-floor/lib   # -> 0 non-comment hits; asserted by both selftests
founder_receipt.trust_root: the SHA256 fingerprint pinned in config/hosts/<host>.json founder_trust_root.public_key_fingerprint. The environment variable may only LOCATE a key; a fingerprint mismatch is FOUNDER_PUBKEY_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH.
founder_receipt.canonical_body: jq -S -c 'del(.signature)' receipt.json > body   (the exact bytes signed, including jq's trailing newline)
founder_receipt.signing_procedure: ssh-keygen -Y sign -f <founder private key> -n foundergate.founder-receipt.v2 body; then jq -S --rawfile s body.sig '. + {signature:$s}' receipt.json
founder_receipt.shape_rules: the key set must be exactly the bound fields plus 'signature', in sorted order, with no duplicates; anything else is FOUNDER_RECEIPT_MALFORMED before any cryptography runs
founder_receipt.one_time_use: consumption is recorded in the keyed control/CONSUMED_RECEIPTS.json ledger AND as a founder_receipt_consumed event in the keyed, length-anchored chain. A missing or unreadable ledger is a refusal (FOUNDER_RECEIPT_LEDGER_CONSUMED_LEDGER_MISSING), never treated as unspent.
founder_receipt.effect: config/hosts/m4.json ships founder_trust_root.public_key_fingerprint = null, so the merge gate refuses by construction with FOUNDER_TRUST_ROOT_NOT_ENROLLED until a founder pins a real fingerprint

m4_bootstrap.package_digests_are: an INTEGRITY check only, never authenticity; the manifest ships inside the tree it describes and regenerating it is two lines of shell
m4_bootstrap.why_the_dirty_worktree_check_matters: modifying a package file and regenerating PACKAGE_DIGESTS.txt leaves HEAD untouched but the worktree dirty; committing the modification moves HEAD. Either way the external anchor fails.

unified_commands.compatibility_wrappers: not shipped; omitted to stay within the authorized file cap. The host-neutral commands are the interface.

limitations: role separation is NOT a security boundary against a hostile process running as the same macOS user; it is accident resistance plus an audit trail
every keyed seal is keyed with control/.writer_secret, readable by that same user; the seals make tampering visible, not impossible
the external event-chain witness is written by the same user on the same machine; it is not an independent notary

the founder key fingerprint and the enrollment authority fingerprint are pinned in package files, so an actor who can rewrite the working tree can rewrite the pins; the external --expect-sha/--expect-tree anchor and the clean-worktree requirement exist for exactly this reason
no live tmux verification is recorded in this file; re-run both selftests on the target host
no role has ever been launched through this package
the M4 repository path and origin basename are defaults and must be confirmed on the M4
no founder verification key is enrolled and no machine is enrolled, so the merge gate and every M4 authority path refuse by construction

not_enforced.detail: All role windows run as one macOS uid. The per-run writer secret at control/.writer_secret is readable by that uid, and an actor who reads it can recompute the role capability commitments, artifact MACs, lease seals, retry ledger seal and event chain digests. The previous claim 'No role can impersonate another role's state writer' was disproved by independent audit and has been removed. Role separation here is accident resistance plus an audit trail, not forgery resistance.
not_enforced.what_would_be_required: separate OS users with filesystem ACLs on the run root, or separate machines; neither is implemented

host_enrollment.why: --host m4 is profile selection, not physical-host attestation. An earlier version allowed a full seven-window M4 floor with merge authority to start on an M1.
host_enrollment.required_for: any profile carrying serial_integration_writer, protected_main_writer, final_integration_verifier or merge_sheriff authority; derived from the authority set, not from a profile boolean
host_enrollment.effect: config/hosts/m4.json ships host_enrollment.enrollment_authority_fingerprint = null, so every M4 authority path refuses with HOST_ENROLLMENT_NOT_CONFIGURED
